parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, title, source_engine, created_at::date AS since FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 15) t) AS tasks,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, engine, left(reason, 120) AS reason, created_at::date AS since FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) a) AS approvals,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(g), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, topic FROM emma_agenda WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) g) AS agenda,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.created_at), '[]') FROM (SELECT left(input, 200) AS input, left(output, 200) AS output, created_at FROM interaction_memory WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) c) AS recent_chat,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, category, content FROM emma_memory ORDER BY importance DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 30) m) AS memory,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(d ORDER BY d.created_at), '[]') FROM (SELECT from_agent, to_agent, left(message, 400) AS message, created_at FROM agent_dialogue WHERE (from_agent = 'JARVIS' OR to_agent = 'JARVIS') AND created_at > now() - interval '3 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6) d) AS jarvis,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(y ORDER BY y.created_at), '[]') FROM (SELECT mode, left(thoughts, 300) AS thoughts, created_at FROM emma_cycles ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3) y) AS last_cycles,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_dialogue WHERE from_agent = 'EMMA' AND to_agent = 'IRINA' AND created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) AS messages_today,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status <> 'ok') AS failed_runs_24h,
  (SELECT min(next_wake_at) FROM emma_cycles WHERE next_wake_at > now()) AS next_planned_wake;
UPDATE emma_tasks SET status = 'done', done_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'open';
INSERT INTO emma_memory (category, content, importance, source) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'SELF');
INSERT INTO agent_dialogue (from_agent, to_agent, message) VALUES ('EMMA', 'IRINA', $1) RETURNING message AS text;
INSERT INTO emma_approvals (engine, reason) VALUES ('EMMA_SELF', $1) RETURNING id, reason;
INSERT INTO emma_cycles (mode, wake_events, thoughts, actions, next_wake_at) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::timestamptz);

SELECT json_build_object(
  'goals', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'goals'),
  'decisions', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'decisions'),
  'strategies', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'strategies'),
  'market_intel', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'market_intel'),
  'learnings', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'learnings'),
  'people', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'people'),
  'preferences', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'importance', importance, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_memory WHERE category = 'preferences'),
  'conversations', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('ts', created_at, 'irina', input, 'emma', output) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM (SELECT * FROM interaction_memory WHERE output IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50) c),
  'tasks', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'title', title, 'since', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open'),
  'agenda_mit_irina', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'topic', topic, 'reason', reason) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_agenda WHERE status = 'open'),
  'pending_approvals', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'reason', reason) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending'),
  'jarvis_dialogue', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('from', from_agent, 'to', to_agent, 'message', message, 'ts', created_at) ORDER BY created_at), '[]') FROM (SELECT * FROM agent_dialogue WHERE from_agent = 'JARVIS' OR to_agent = 'JARVIS' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30) d),
  'last_thoughts', (SELECT json_build_object('mode', mode, 'thoughts', thoughts, 'ts', created_at) FROM emma_cycles ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1),
  'next_wake', (SELECT min(next_wake_at) FROM emma_cycles WHERE next_wake_at > now()),
  'last_updated', now()
) AS memory;
